## visualization
In [22]:
sns.countplot(x="Gender",data=df)
plt.title("Gender Distribution")
plt.xlabel("Gender")
plt.ylabel("count")
plt.show()

Male and female students are almost equally distributed in the dataset¶

In [ ]:

plt.title("Age Distribution")

plt.show()

the student's ages range from 18 to 34 years,with an average age of about 26 years¶

In [ ]:

conclusion¶

the dataset was analyzed using exploratory data analysis techniques the analysis included data cleaning,statistical summary,gender, age,BMI,diabetes, smoking,and cholesterol analysis

Groupby analysis was used to compare BMI,Weight and cholesterol between different groups.visualization techniques such as count plots,histograms, scatter plots, box plots and a correlation heatmap were used to understand patterns and relationships in the dataset

the cleaned dataset was finally saved for further analysis
